# Psalm 70 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. Of-David. To-bring-to-remembrance.

**2** O-God, to-deliver-me — YHWH, to-my-help — hasten!

**3** Let-them-be-put-to-shame and-humiliated, those-seeking my-soul; let-them-be-turned-back and-disgraced, those-delighting in-my-harm.

**4** Let-them-turn-back because-of their-shame, those-saying, 'Aha! Aha!'

**5** Let-all those-seeking-You rejoice and-be-glad in-You; and-let-those-loving Your-salvation say continually, 'Great [is] God!'

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **70:1**: Nearly identical to Psalm 40:14-18. This abbreviated version may have been extracted for independent liturgical use.

— EMET
